rationale: Image-only rounded tiles, 3 per row; a final odd item spans the full width as a wide panorama.
visualCharacteristics.purpose: image-only gallery grid, three tiles per row, with a trailing odd tile spanning full width

contentPattern.description: Repeating look-alike images in a wrapping grid: Cards (image-only). 4 rows, image in first cell, text cell empty (alt text kept on images).
contentPattern.structure: one row per tile: cell 1 image (alt text required); cell 2 optional caption (usually empty)

cells: Text content (empty for cards-gallery; label for cards-ticker)

usage: Use for photo galleries. Add 3n+1 images to get a full-width panorama as the last tile.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for any image-only tile grid. For cards with text use a text cards variant.
